text:
Elena Park: quick UX pass from today's sync — focus: how encryption & key info surfaces across the console and in exports. uploaded mock in figma: https://redwood.app/figma/key-visibility-v1 :mag:
Jon Wu: nice! my first read: we show a 'Key' column in the table with a padlock icon, but the padlock alone doesn't explain ownership. can we make the visible label read either 'Redwood key' / 'Customer key' ?
Priya Shah: +1. avoid acronyms like BYOK in the main UI. keep the pill short, but tooltip can include 'Customer-managed (BYOK)'. Also include a screenreader-friendly aria-label that reads the full phrase.
Marcus Bell: small accessibility thing: padlock icon currently has title text only on hover. Make it keyboard focusable and add aria-describedby that points to the tooltip content.
Elena Park: agreed. also consider adding a context menu on the row with 'View key details' so reviewers can pull KMS metadata (key id, provider). clicking should open a small dialog (role=dialog) with copyable key id.
Jon Wu: about CSV/JSON export: include both a human label and a machine field. e.g., CSV columns: 'KMS label','kms_type' where kms_type is one of [redwood, customer, none]. and in the JSON export include key_id when kms_type=customer.
Priya Shah: copy nit for the KMS tooltip: current "Managed by customer" is bland. propose: 'Customer-managed key: stored and controlled in your KMS; Redwood does not retain the raw key.' Keep under 120 chars.
Marcus Bell: visual contrast: the key pill background is pale green which fails contrast with white at small sizes. switch to darker stroke + white text or use a badge icon plus plain text to meet 4.5:1.
Elena Park: one more: when users toggle an org-wide policy (e.g., force customer keys), we show a toast "Policy applied". needs aria-live and the message to include scope: 'Encryption policy "Customer key required" applied to org: Acme Corp (enforced in EU-west)'.
Jon Wu: behavior note: if a row's key status is synced from org policy, show a small lock-with-badge icon and tooltip 'Enforced by org policy'. avoid making it editable inline. make inline edits show a confirmation explaining enforcement.
Priya Shah: test plan: i'll run through keyboard-only flows for the row actions, the key details dialog, and the toast announcements. will also write final tooltip strings and short CSV header examples.
accessibility-bot: accessibility-check: key badge contrast fails on 2/3 sample sizes; recommend darker fill and explicit focus outline.
Marcus Bell: dev note: backend needs to emit kms_type, key_id (nullable), and policy_enforced boolean on audit and list endpoints so UI can render all of this without guessing.
Elena Park: great — i'll update the figma + copy doc and attach the export header examples. leaving thread open for any final microcopy tweaks before I upload a preview build.
Jon Wu: one last microcopy: export header suggestion: 'Event Time','Actor','Action','KMS Label','kms_type','Key ID','Regions' — keeps both human and machine parsers happy.
Priya Shah: thanks, team. i'll circle back after the keyboard pass. :sparkles:
